summary: Serina Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K reporting that the independent Safety Monitoring Committee completed a blinded review of Cohort 1 in its Phase 1b registrational study of SER-252 in advanced Parkinson's disease and recommended advancing to Cohort 2. No financial terms, securities transactions, or corporate actions are involved; the disclosure concerns clinical development progress and a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1. Topline data from the single-ascending-dose portion are expected in the first half of 2027. No deal, vote, or capital markets event is present.
